title.en: Express questionnaire on the readiness of a site for investment

title.uz: Korxona ustavi va YeGRPO dan ko'chirma
title.ru: Устав предприятия и выписка из ЕГРПО
title.en: Company charter and extract from the state register (EGRPO)

documents.description: Item 1 of step 3 of the questionnaire: the current company charter and an extract from the unified state register of enterprises and organisations (ЕГРПО).

checks: It is a company charter (Устав / Устав), not another document.
The company name matches the client's company, if it is known.
It shows that it was approved and registered (date, founders' decision, registration mark or QR code).
It is an extract from the state register of legal entities (ЕГРПО, issued by the state services centre or my.gov.uz).
The company name and STIR (INN) are shown and match the client's company, if it is known; the head is named.
It is recent: issued no more than 3 months before today.

title.uz: Yer qa'ridan foydalanish ruxsatnomasi (litsenziya) va litsenziya kelishuvi
title.ru: Разрешение / лицензия на недропользование и лицензионное соглашение (шартнома)
title.en: Subsoil use permit (licence) and licence agreement

documents.description: Item 2 of step 3: the electronic subsoil use permit / licence and the licence agreement (шартнома, subsoil use conditions) under Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 133.

checks: It is a subsoil use permit or licence (рухсатнома / разрешение / лицензия), usually with a QR code.
It has a number, an issue date and the holder; the holder matches the client's company, if known.
It is not expired today (if a validity date is shown).
It is a licence agreement or subsoil use conditions document (лицензия келишуви / лицензионное соглашение / ер қаъридан фойдаланиш шартлари / шартнома).
It names the subsoil user and refers to the permit or plot.
It is signed (signature, electronic signature or QR code).

title.uz: Loyiha hujjatlari (UTER, TIA, tog' ajratmasi loyihasi) va 5-GR tasdig'i
title.ru: Проектная документация (УТЭР, ТЭО, проект горного отвода) и подтверждение сдачи 5-ГР
title.en: Project documents (UTER, feasibility study, mining allotment) and proof of form 5-GR

documents.description: Item 3 of step 3: project documentation of the site and a document confirming that the annual geological report form 5-GR was submitted.

checks: It is one of: geological exploration project (ГҚИ / ГРР), UTER (УТЭР), feasibility study (ТИА / ТЭО), mining allotment project (тоғ ажратмаси / горный отвод), working project or topographic survey.
It names the site or the company.
It shows an approval, agreement or expert review mark, or at least a date and the developer.
It is form 5-GR (5-ГР) with an acceptance mark, or a receipt / letter confirming that it was submitted.
It shows the reporting year and the company or site.
The reporting year is the last or the year before last.

documents.description: Item 4 of step 3: environmental documents of the site — ZVOS / ZEP (environmental impact statements), PDV (emissions), PDS (discharges), waste limits — and the state environmental expert review conclusion.

checks: It is one or more of: ZVOS / ZEP / OVOS, PDV, PDS or waste limits project, or the state environmental expert review conclusion.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (3 years for EIA materials, 5 years for environmental standards).

title.uz: Sanoat xavfsizligi ekspertizasi (EPB) dalolatnomalari va yer ajratmasi to'g'risidagi qarorlar
title.ru: Акты экспертизы промышленной безопасности (ЭПБ) по ОПО и решения на земельный отвод
title.en: Industrial safety expert review (EPB) reports and land allotment decisions

documents.description: Item 5 of step 3: industrial safety expert review reports / conclusions for the hazardous production facilities (ОПО) and the decisions on the land allotment.

checks: It is an industrial safety expert review conclusion or report (ЭПБ / саноат хавфсизлиги экспертизаси), a registration of a hazardous production facility (ОПО) or a permit to operate it.
It names the company or the facility.
It has a number and a date and comes from an accredited expert organisation or the competent authority.
It is a land allotment decision (hokim's decision / қарор / решение), a land lease agreement or a cadastre document for the site.
It names the company and the plot (area, location).
It has a number and a date.

documents.description: The express questionnaire itself (Uzbek or Russian version), filled in and signed by the owner. Not one of the 5 required documents, but welcome: it gives the company name and the items marked 'not applicable'.

checks: It is this questionnaire (title 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТА' / 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТАСИ'), not another document.
Company name, full name and position of the person who filled it in, contact phone or Telegram, and the name of the deposit / subsoil plot are filled in (not blank lines or underscores).
Direction A (geological exploration) or B (mining / gold) is marked in step 1, and in each of the 10 items of step 2 one option is marked or the item is marked as not applicable (NA).
The owner's consent block (NDA) has the position, a signature and a date. A stamp is welcome but not required.
